courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」與「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" and "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心筒與八根巨柱」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core and eight mega-columns” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形；高層建築差異縮短補償則以預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement; Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings centres on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core and eight mega-columns” and “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 樂天世界塔
history.text: 樂天集團自 1980 年代末就研究在首爾蠶室興建地標塔，先後考慮約十種其他方案後選定 Kohn Pedersen Fox 的錐形設計；Leslie E. Robertson Associates 擔任結構設計，Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants 為在地結構技師、Thornton Tomasetti 做同儕審查，樂天建設負責施工。2009 年開始方案設計，2011 年動工，2015 年 12 月結構封頂，2016 年 3 月頂部燈籠完成，2017 年 4 月開幕，成為韓國最高建築。工程上的特色在於以核心筒、巨柱、外伸臂與帶狀桁架組成系統，並用延遲接頭、巨柱預拱與長期力量設計處理差異變形。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Lotte Group studied a landmark tower at Jamsil in Seoul from the late 1980s and, after considering about ten other designs, chose the tapered design by Kohn Pedersen Fox; Leslie E. Robertson Associates was the design structural engineer, Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants the local engineer of record, Thornton Tomasetti the peer reviewer and Lotte Engineering & Construction the builder. Schematic design began in 2009, construction in 2011, the structure topped out in December 2015, the lantern was completed in March 2016 and the tower opened in April 2017 as Korea's tallest building. Its engineering signature is a system of core, mega-columns, outriggers and belt trusses, with delayed joints, mega-column camber and long-term force design to manage differential movement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」到「結構健康監測與營運交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" through "Structural health monitoring and operational handover" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
